meta.description: Compare tab. Lets a Pro user overlay their current dynamic code against up to 3 of their other dynamic codes on one line chart. generateQR.name: generateQR
generateQR.description: Generates a QR code via window.QREngine.create(config), injects the SVG into targetId's innerHTML, and triggers 'result' with {svg, info, analysis, error} (or 'error' on failure).

downloadQR.name: downloadQR
downloadQR.description: Downloads the last generated QR code. format 'svg' calls qr.downloadSVG(); format 'png' calls qr.downloadPNG(px).

uploadLogo.name: uploadLogo
uploadLogo.description: Reads an image File (from a file input change event) as a data URL and triggers 'result' with { dataUrl } (or 'error' on failure).

setAuthCookies.name: setAuthCookies
setAuthCookies.description: Sets access and refresh token cookies from the login response

loginUser.name: loginUser
loginUser.description: Logs in a user against Supabase, sets auth cookies, and redirects to dashboard.

createDynamicCode.name: createDynamicCode
createDynamicCode.description: Creates a dynamic short code row in Supabase (codes table) for the given destination and triggers 'result' with the short URL (https://qr.engineer/{id}) or 'error' on failure. Mirrors generateQR's event-based conventions.

loadMyCodes.name: loadMyCodes
loadMyCodes.description: Fetches the current user's dynamic codes (with scan counts) from Supabase and triggers 'result' with the rows or 'error' on failure. Mirrors createDynamicCode's event-based conventions.

startProCheckout.name: startProCheckout
startProCheckout.description: Reads the qr_access_token cookie and POSTs it to the QR billing Worker to create a Stripe checkout session, then redirects to the returned checkout URL.

manageBilling.name: manageBilling
manageBilling.description: Reads the qr_access_token cookie and POSTs it to the QR billing Worker /portal endpoint to open the Stripe customer portal, then redirects to the returned portal URL.

saveStaticCode.name: saveStaticCode
saveStaticCode.description: Inserts a static QR code row (type='static') into Supabase codes table with template, payload and config. The generated 6-char id is stored as PK but not used as a link. Triggers 'result' with { id } or 'error' on failure.

downloadFramed.name: downloadFramed
downloadFramed.description: Rasterizes the framed QR preview DOM element (frame + caption + QR SVG) into an image and downloads it. format 'svg' downloads the composed SVG; otherwise a PNG at px size.

downloadBlob.name: downloadBlob
downloadBlob.description: Triggers a client-side file download from an in-memory string. Creates a Blob, an object URL and a synthetic anchor click, then revokes the object URL. No server round trip. args: content (string), filename (string), mimeType (optional, defaults to text/csv;charset=utf-8).

handleOAuthCallback.name: handleOAuthCallback
handleOAuthCallback.description: Reads OAuth tokens from the URL hash, stores them as cookies, and redirects to the dashboard or login page

qrSvg.name: qrSvg
qrSvg.description: Encodes text into a QR code and renders it as an SVG string. Supports module shapes: square, rounded, dots.

effectivePeriod.name: effectivePeriod
effectivePeriod.description: Shared gating rule for analytics tabs. Pro users send their selected PeriodToggle value (7d/30d/90d/all); free users always send 30d so buckets/rows past the free threshold can be peek-gated.

toCsv.name: toCsv
toCsv.description: Serialises an array of row objects to an Excel-safe CSV string. columns = [{key, header}]. Prepends a UTF-8 BOM, guards against formula injection (values starting with = + - @ tab or CR get a leading single quote), RFC-escapes fields containing comma/quote/newline, renders dates as ISO 8601 and numbers plain (no % sign).

buildRhythmGrid.name: buildRhythmGrid
buildRhythmGrid.description: Expands a sparse rhythm RPC response (only non-zero {dow, hour, scans} cells) into the full dense 168-row grid with zeros filled in, ordered by dow (0=Sunday, Postgres convention) then hour. Each row carries the human day name (Monday..Sunday), the numeric dow_postgres (0=Sunday), the hour, and scans. Someone pivoting this in a spreadsheet needs the zeros present and readable day names.
